name: Dirham world halal
description:
Dirham World Halal (DWH) is a premium digital asset built around the principles of ethical finance, transparency, and exclusivity. Designed with a Sharia-inspired vision, DWH aims to support a financial ecosystem focused on responsible digital asset ownership and long-term utility.

Operating on the BNB Smart Chain, DWH combines blockchain technology with a distinctive approach to digital finance, emphasizing transparency, accessibility, and sustainable ecosystem development.

The project promotes a financial philosophy that excludes interest-based mechanisms (Riba), leverage, and staking-based returns, with a focus on spot ownership and real utility.

Dirham World Halal seeks to establish a prestigious and globally accessible digital ecosystem.
